subject: Final MAP acceptance & updated quote for evaluation ramp
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@acme.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP checkpoints and preliminary pricing

Kimberly / Grace —

Thanks for the draft MAP last week. We reviewed the milestones internally and have two asks before we can move to procurement:

- Confirm the acceptance criteria for MAP checkpoint 2 (evaluation pass/fail metrics + sample prompt set).
- Provide a firm quote showing the commit tiers and associated discounts if we move to a 12-month ramp starting July 1.

We want to run a 6-week evaluation with a small ramp (10% expected production traffic) and then a staged increase to 60% by Month 3 if MAP checkpoints are met. Can you map pricing to that ramp (including unit token pricing and any overage rules)?

Appreciate a single PDF that summarizes the MAP and the final commercial (we'll need it for our procurement review).

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Head of AI Integrations
Acme Financial

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-26T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoints and preliminary pricing

Elena —

Thanks for the clear timeline. Attached are two files: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (single-page summary) and MAP_Acme_v2.xlsx (detailed checkpoints + acceptance criteria). Highlights below: 

- Evaluation plan: 6 weeks total. Checkpoint 1 (end of week 2): connectivity, ingest, sample prompts validated. Checkpoint 2 (end of week 4): quality regression < 3% on the agreed prompt set and latency 99p < 450ms. Final acceptance (end of week 6): production readiness and SLA signoff.
- Ramp & pricing: Proposed staged ramp starting 10% (Week 1–2), 30% (Week 3–4), 60%+ (Month 3). Pricing model attached includes: base per-token rate, reserved commit tiers (monthly), and overage at a discounted rate once commit is met.
- Discount structure: 10% off list for a 6-month commit at the proposed mid-tier, 18% off for a 12-month commit, and an additional 2% for multi-region (if requested).

If this aligns, we'll produce a final quote (DocuSign-ready) and include the HubSpot deal link for procurement. Would you be able to confirm checkpoint 2 acceptance criteria by Jun 10 so we can lock the July 1 ramp start?

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (PDF, 128KB); MAP_Acme_v2.xlsx (Excel, 54KB)

Best,
Kimberly Park
Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoints and preliminary pricing

Quick thought on pricing tiers — adding here for visibility.

- Suggest we add a 90-day early-pay discount (4%) for the 12-month commit; procurement teams like that.
- For the evaluation, let's include a capped burst buffer (30% additional capacity for 2 weeks) at a nominal fee so they can stress test without surprise overages.

I'll update the proposal if Kimberly wants these woven in.

—Marcus
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@acme.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoints and preliminary pricing

Kimberly / Marcus —

This looks good overall. Two follow-ups from our security and procurement desks: 

1) Security asked for a short note confirming data retention behavior during evaluation and that KV cache won't be persisted beyond session boundaries for PII-sensitive prompts. We attached a short doc with their checklist (acme_compliance_requirements.docx).
2) Procurement asked if the 12-month commitment discount can be clarified in the quote to show both the base and effective per-token price at the 60% ramp target. They also liked Marcus' early-pay idea.

We confirm we can meet the Jun 10 internal deadline to sign off on checkpoint 2, provided we get the final quote by Jun 4. Can you send the DocuSign-ready agreement with the final numbers?

Thanks —
Elena

Date: 2026-06-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoints and preliminary pricing — Final quote and signature request

Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the speedy review. Attached is the DocuSign-ready commercial (redwood_proposal_v3.pdf — updated) which incorporates:

- 12-month commit pricing with the 18% standard discount + 4% early-pay discount (effective discount 20.3% after compounding), and the clarified effective per-token prices at the 60% ramp target.
- A capped burst buffer for evaluation (30% for 14 days) and explicit overage rules (overage billed at committed discounted rate).
- Security note: KV cache is session-scoped and not persisted to long-term storage; logs are retained per our standard 30-day eval retention policy. See attached acme_compliance_requirements.docx for their checklist.

We also included a one-sheet MAP acceptance checklist at the top of the DocuSign package so procurement can sign checkpoint acceptance as discrete line items. If all looks good, please sign via the DocuSign link below by Jun 4 to keep the July 1 ramp start intact.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/SignACME-987654
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/ACME-2026-01

Next steps after signature:
- Redwood: Provision dedicated evaluation capacity, set up monitoring dashboards, attach MAP checkpoints to the deal in HubSpot.
- Acme: Execute evaluation, run sample prompt set, and provide checkpoint evidence by Jun 10.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142
